quest.016DD988006CE82F.quest_desc: You will only need &#FF0000&lone&r per &#FF7F00exporter&r and &#00FF00importer&r.

quest.02A1C699031C7DBD.quest_desc: This feature only works while playing with &#1E90FFsomeone&r. If you are playing alone, you can skip this long text.

To combact this, there is &#00FF7Fsecurity manager&r and &#FF00FFsecurity cards&r to allows X person to do Y thing in your network, like &#FF4500breaking&r your network.
Fallback cards is used for everyone else that you don't define. &#7FFF00Deny everyone&r to do anything on your network is the best advice if you don't know them
quest.02B6E87C67A4BFFE.quest_desc: Well, faster they are, but has a more expensive craft, &#8B00FFelite version&r of these are not needed since &#00FF00speed upgrades&r and &#FF7F00stack upgrades&r do a much better job

quest.051127715A95CF0C.quest_desc: There is &#FF4500more upgrades&r, not only to those 4 items, but for more of them!
quest.0587A48E22302D5A.quest_desc: Using some &#FFFF00Quartz&r and some &#FF4500copper&r, we can get some &#00FF7Fconductive materials&r, enough for making &#00CED1disks&r or even some &#FF00FFcables&r!
quest.0904759478C30258.quest_desc: Allows to &#00FFFFcopy information&r from one RS machine to another easily.

quest.097A4211FC939AE0.quest_desc: &#FF7F00External storages&r makes visibles other inventories like your drawer wall or your starter chests

quest.0A353AC5FF2EE8C8.quest_desc: Stores &#00CED1Source&r for later use in multiblocks or any &#FF69B4Ars Source Jar&r
quest.0A353AC5FF2EE8C8.quest_subtitle: &#8B00FF&oIf magic can be digitalized, are we in a simulation?&r
quest.0F9E52B5BC4CB50A.quest_desc: RS has few addons, but those are &#FF4500powerful&r, similar to AE2 ones!
First block allows to connect &#1E90FFReplication network&r to RS
And the second block allows the &#FF00FFSchematicannon&r from Create to use items from your network
How can this be good? Well, your storage is &#7FFF00more powerful&r than some chests!
quest.0F9E52B5BC4CB50A.title: &#FFD700&lRS addons&r
quest.105C3E68750E1FFE.quest_desc: This little block allows you to send signals &#FFD700across multiple dimensions&r and without a range limit, making it the perfect &#00FF00material saving&r in RS.
Consumes the same as a &#FF7F00wireless transmitter&r with &#FF14934 range upgrades&r
quest.19A8F79F2E415847.quest_desc: There are other versions of &#FF69B4autocrafters&r that is similar to these, but they don't allow chaining or doesn't do it correctly
quest.1B35CEDB1939C1D1.quest_desc: &#1E90FF48 blocks&r seems little? Well, here is an upgraded version, which &#7FFF00infinite range&r. But no cross dimension range, thats for later!
quest.1C39960D4E84A92B.quest_desc: As simple as it can get, these little ones do 1 job of the &#FFD700interface&r, but saves space in some setups.
The bad news is that is &#FF0000not as fast&r as an interface
quest.1C39960D4E84A92B.title: &#FF00FF&lIn and Out&r
quest.1EDBE9BF623A4C55.quest_desc: Unlike Applied Energistics 2 (AE2), &#FFD700Refine Storage (RS)&r is simpler, with less "yOU nEed ti Do thIS thiS WaY".
RS has less addons to it, but still &#FF4500powerful enough&r for most cases, like &#1E90FFEnergy storage&r or &#8B00FFSoul Energy&r.
It needs a bit more space to do a setup, but a lot has changed since &#7FFF001.20.1&r, so give it a try!
Lastly, RS has some &#FF69B4QoL&r that AE2 doesn't ;p
quest.1F283A782C2B63FB.quest_desc: Allows to store &#FF1493256 buckets&r of fluids
quest.20768C57F07A8F58.quest_desc: This is the best way to send your network &#FF00FFacross dimensions&r or long distances, saving in lag and loading chunks!

Place the receiver in the place you want, sneak right click on it with a &#FFFF00network card&r, go to your base and place the card on a &#00FF00transmitter&r. And you have your network wirelessly connected.
Can't be connected in a network separated with a &#FF0000Relay&r, due to loop!
quest.217C4AC06B6EBEDF.quest_desc: Glue is an &#FF4500important material&r, holding the &#00FF7Fglass&r, &#1E90FFsilicon&r and the frame
quest.2417436EE3CCEEFD.quest_desc: Now that we are talking about wireless, here it's how you can access your network from "far", just &#7FFF0016 blocks&r, but we will improve it!
Just place it somewhere near where you are going to need it
quest.2449BC8D9D70AEF5.quest_desc: This is your &#FF7F00first terminal&r, able to see all materials in your networks. It has low functionalities, perfect for just seeing what is doing a setup.
You can &#00FF00extract&r and &#00FFFFinsert&r items to the network's storages
quest.245A46C88B6EF096.quest_desc: It's cheap, just made from &#FFFF00glue&r and &#00FF7Firon&r and some other materials
quest.25514C1608CE1DB9.quest_desc: Allows to store some of the &#FF00FFchemicals&r in your network.
Doesn't store nuclear waste nor spent nuclear waste. But you can use &#FFD700interfaces&r from RS to delete them safely, without spreading &#FF0000radiation&r
quest.25D07D5C1BF155D0.quest_desc: Allows to store &#1E90FF1024 buckets&r of fluids
quest.2607CCE7E9B43E4F.quest_desc: Instead of having 10 controllers, lets have &#00CED11&r.
Now, you would just need to store some energy in an &#FF69B4energy cell&r and it will automatically pull from it
quest.28E924449849D8DC.quest_desc: Storage is a bit weirder in RS than AE2.
It has no type (except for &#FFFF00energy&r, &#8B00FFsouls&r and &#00CED1source&r), yet they are better than AE2.
The disk information is stored as a &#00FF00file&r instead of NBT, so you won't be able to chunk ban your base. But that also means that you can edit the content of it externally or get corrupted.
quest.2B78719A7D55EF02.quest_desc: This is the &#FF1493main block&r in this entire mod, the controller.
Stores energy and handle the network so everything can work.
You can connect multiple of them in the same network, no need to touch. I wouldn't put a lot of them. I would say &#00FF7F10&r is a good number for any network.
Energy is per controller, doesn't share it with others.
Speaking of energy, RS is &#1E90FFmore energy efficient&r than AE2!
quest.2D3EF621FB6C3C7E.quest_desc: Unlike AE2 (by default), RS has &#FF00FFno channel limits&r, making your imagination go freely, without thinking "Do i have a channel for the 9th import bus?"
You can connect different parts of your network with this block, althought, for dimensional transport or big distances, there will be another method &#7FFF00much better&r.
quest.2F3F84A04ECA4026.quest_desc: Even if you don't know, this is a &#FFD700fundamental material&r in your machines, able to flip from 1 to 0 and viceversa in rapid sucessions.
We use it to calculate faster how fast your machine will consume your resources (Spoiler: Never!).
You can get a lot of &#00FF00silicon&r from multiple places
quest.31811595C0106A95.quest_desc: It basically allows you to do &#FF69B4recursive craftings&r, like the smithing patterns.
Did you know that recursive can be &#FF0000bad for computers&r? Well, because it can need a lot of memory and processing, so make sure you don't abuse them!
quest.347632C49FE9FEC1.quest_desc: These little machines are useful in some scenarios like automating &#00FF7Fore processing&r or some farms like &#1E90FFamethyst buddings&r.
They have a &#FFFF00filter&r, no need for external storage one!
quest.347632C49FE9FEC1.title: &#FF7F00&lBuild and Destroy&r
quest.361A7FB71B620A7D.quest_desc: &#00FF00Faster operations&r, up to &#FF00FF4 upgrades&r at the same time, yes, but it has a catch on some scenarios.

If you only need constant items, for example, 2 per second, 4 speed upgrades is more than enough, but if you need, lets say, 128 items per second, you want to mix &#FF1493speed&r and &#00CED1stack upgrades&r!
These are usually the ones that get chopped down to put other upgrades
quest.36C471AB6F800F71.quest_desc: These little upgrades sends or extract &#FF4500more in one operation&r.
Here is the trick, you need &#FFFF004&r to do &#1E90FF1 Stack&r at the time, and the best tiers of importer/exporter has only 4 slots, so there will be a mix of upgrades in some setups
quest.383079759AD50C01.quest_subtitle: &#FFD700&oWell, cheaper than AE2 but less space&r
quest.3BBD56100AA2CE9F.quest_desc: Allows to place a &#FF00FFpattern&r without going to the autocrafter itself.
A more abstract way, but it will &#00FFFFsave you tons of time&r
quest.3E597A49C08A0DD9.quest_desc: Unlike AE2, this is a single block to create &oSUBNETS&r with tons of configuration, &#00FF00less resources needed&r in general.
In a nutshell, you can give a &#FF7F00redstone signal&r to shut down or start a part of your network. Needs some time to perform the operation
By default, it pass everything from your main network, although, this can be customized to only make the main network see 1 pattern or only 1 item or pass energy to the subnet.
quest.41F760033B93D949.quest_desc: Stores &#FF14931 FE per byte&r. There is higher tiers versions. Needs to use
quest.441776FD491161A8.quest_desc: It allows you to &#FF0000stop any recipe&r or see what the &#7FFF00autocrafters&r are doing
quest.445C903E107D3377.quest_desc: Put the &#FF69B4encoded pattern&r inside this machine and it will do its magic. There is a few things to consider:
- It can only output to &#FF4500one directly&r, it has a point in the middle of the texture
- You can connect &#00FF7Fmultiple of them&r! Just need to point another autocrafter to the back of another
- It has some useful stuff that AE2 one's doesn't like &#00CED1pulling the result&r directly to the autocrafter.
quest.46841515ABD31F9D.quest_desc: Although, you won't use the first block a lot in RS, the second one is handy:
- Allows to pass content from &#FF7F00disk A&r to &#FFFF00disk B&r
- Keep a &#FF1493certain amount in stock&r, so you don't have to constantly keep making them
quest.46841515ABD31F9D.title: &#8B00FF&lMore useful item&r
quest.4755C24BF0872B7E.quest_desc: These are some essential items for some of the &#00FFFFsetups automation&r, for example, knowing if you have &#7FFF00X amount&r of items before sending them to a machine to process or just knowing how much do you have in storage in a glance.
quest.4755C24BF0872B7E.title: &#FF00FF&lUseful items&r
quest.4859B478F0087F85.quest_desc: This is the &#FF4500most expensive raw&r, but has one particularity. It &#FFD700shines&r!

quest.4C7664721EB699C2.quest_desc: &#FFFF00Patterns&r are an essential part of any game, allowing you to automate the some of the more tedious processes in a mod in &#00FF00just 1 click&r.

quest.57334B9B0D70FCE4.quest_desc: Allows to store &#FFD70064 buckets&r of fluids

quest.7C884AC9E223B34F.quest_desc: Althought this is made from iron, it's extremely good at resisting hits. Good for &#FF4500most machines&r!
quest.7ED4B34C4B6999BF.quest_desc: Do you need &#7FFF00faster&r and &#FF69B4more slots&r? Here is your solution
